review: independent AI visual and source-caption QA

assets.positiveFinding: Soap washing, running-water rinse and disposable-paper drying are depicted.
assets.requiredCaptionJa: 手洗いの一部を示す模式例です。最初の予洗い、指先・爪・手首の洗い方、資料の約30秒・約20秒の目安、職場で定めた消毒は、この絵だけでは分かりません。本文と職場の手順を確認してください。
dangerousInterpretationsPrevented: Not all five source steps depicted; no exact duration depicted.
Raised/rolled sleeves and no mask: not a correct-workwear guide.
No claim that picture verifies complete washing technique.

assets.positiveFinding: Metal/glass examples, chemicals beside food and schematic microorganisms provide illustrative hazard recognition.
assets.requiredCaptionJa: 危害要因を考えるための例です。薬剤と食品が並ぶ棚は、まねをしてはいけない保管例です。薬剤は食品と混同せず、表示と所定の保管場所を守ります。拡大した微生物は模式図で、見た目による種類の判定はできません。
dangerousInterpretationsPrevented: Chemical-food co-storage is unsafe and must be identified explicitly.
Microorganism shapes are schematic, not diagnostic or to scale.
Foreign object size/material does not exhaust hazard classifications.

assets.positiveFinding: Hair containment, mask, closedworkwear, finalmirrorcheck and glovefitting support personalhygiene examples.
assets.requiredCaptionJa: 服装確認と手袋の装着を考える模式例です。手洗い、着用順序、髪や袖口、手袋の大きさ・破れ・汚れは本文と職場のルールで確認します。
dangerousInterpretationsPrevented: Does not teach five-stage dressing order.
Does not establish hygiene of unseen glove or hands.
Do not use generic blue glove as proof of cut/heat/chemical protection.

assets.positiveFinding: Two visually divided work areas show raw and cooked food separation.
assets.requiredCaptionJa: 原料側と調理後の食品側を分ける考え方の例です。器具、手袋、服装、人や物の移動も含め、実際の区分と切替手順は職場で確認します。
dangerousInterpretationsPrevented: Static divider alone does not prove effective zoning.
Do not treat illustration as knife-technique instruction.
Does not demonstrate cleaning/glovechanges or validated flow.

assets.positiveFinding: Closed guard and locked tagged isolator can illustrate separation from hazards and restart prevention.
assets.requiredCaptionJa: 安全カバーと施錠・表示を説明する模式例です。見た目だけで停止や安全を判断せず、電源遮断、再起動防止、残る危険の確認など、権限と職場の手順に従います。
dangerousInterpretationsPrevented: Picture cannot verify zeroenergy, deenergization or residualhazards.
Closedguard/lock image is not permission to reach into machinery.
Do not treat rotary isolator as emergency-stop button.

assets.positiveFinding: Probe insertion and contemporaneous recording illustrate measurement/recording roles.
assets.requiredCaptionJa: 中心温度の測定と記録を考える模式例です。必要な温度・時間、測定位置、器具の管理、原料と調理後食品の区分は、製品と職場の手順で確認します。絵だけで加熱完了や出荷可否を判断しません。
dangerousInterpretationsPrevented: No numerical reading, duration or endpoint verified.
Raw/cooked layout and clothing are not certified by this image.

limitations: All six image pixels inspected and compared with the listed 2026 source concepts.
This is content-image QA only; no current runtime responsive crop/device validation.
Hazards image is unacceptable as a safe-storage model; it can be used only with explicit unsafe-example explanation.
Handwashing image is overview only, not all steps or source timing; not correct-workwear evidence.
